snippet.title: Business Insider
snippet.description:
Business Insider is a global newsroom covering business, technology, and the economy. We help ambitious, curious people stay informed, understand the context, and get ahead.

Our videos break down how industries operate, how decisions get made, and how power and money move across the globe. We report on the companies, people, and trends shaping the world — and explain what it means for your work, money, and future. We publish videos weekly.

Expect explainers, deep dives, and original reporting on AI, markets, leadership, and innovation. Shows include Risky Business, Still Standing, Boot Camp, and So Expensive.

Topics include: business news, tech, AI, markets, finance, leadership, startups, and the global economy.

Visit us: https://www.businessinsider.com/?utm_source=youtube and sign up for newsletters: https://www.businessinsider.com/subscription/newsletter?utm_source=youtube

For licensing requests, contact PARS International: https://www.parsintl.com/publications/insider/

snippet.title: Think Before You Sleep
snippet.description:
If you would like to make a topic request, then send an email to thinkbeforeyousleeprequests@gmail.com

Topic requests should include an article, TV show, Movie, or Twitch Streamer, YouTube video/channel. Please be as specific as possible as to where the source material is. For example, if it's a TV show, I need to know what season and what episode.  If you are requesting a video that is longer than 10 minutes, please include relevant time stamps to interesting things that were said during the video.

Thank you for your help.

If you have business dealings with me please use the business e-mail provided in the "Details" section below. Do not use the request e-mail because your message might not be seen. Any e-mails sent to the business e-mail that have nothing to do with business will be ignored.

snippet.title: George Kamel
snippet.description:
George Kamel is a personal finance expert, #1 National Bestselling Author, and co-host of The Ramsey Show and Smart Money Happy Hour.  Following Ramsey’s proven money plan, George went from negative net worth to a millionaire in under 10 years. His goal is to help people spend less, save more, and avoid money traps so they can live a life with more margin, options and freedom.

This channel will simplify complex money topics, bust money myths with actual facts, and debunk the stupid financial advice you're seeing in your social media feed. All with a healthy dose of pop culture, humor, and snark. New uploads every Monday, Wednesday, & Friday.

Have a story for George? Send us a message to georgeguest@ramseysolutions.com. Want George on your show? Connect with us at georgemedia@ramseysolutions.com.

snippet.title: LYFE Accounting
snippet.description:
LYFE Accounting is a full-service accounting firm that helps individuals and small businesses save on taxes and increase their wealth. 

Taxes are the single largest expense that most people will pay over the course of their life. We teach you how to minimize this expense, while giving you strategies to increase your wealth.

On this channel, we will cover some very important topics such as: 
- How to pay fewer taxes, and some cases, how to pay zero taxes
- How Business entities work such as benefits of LLC, benefits of S Corp, benefits of Sole proprietorship and C Corporations
- How to make smart business & individual investments
- How to build a profitable company 
- How taxes on income work such as taxes on real estate, stocks, etc. 
- Plus more!

Thanks for visiting, and we hope you enjoy our content. If so, please subscribe!
